task.title: Connect real product and model analytics events end to end
task.output: Producer wiring for product visits and 3D start/terminal events
task.accept: 1) The entry is a real GLB load from a product card, triggering POST /api/analytics/events; without consent it must remain operable with no analytics requests, and a product-page visit must not masquerade as a 3D start (E-42, E-46). 2) Each viewId must have only one success/failure terminal event; timeouts and failures must carry actual durationMs, and static fallback must not report success; verify event associations separately for two attempts and for cancellation when switching cards (E-63, E-103).
